subject: Re: NNGP-NAS kickoff — resourcing + annotation UI build
body:
Anders,

Resourcing:

- Freya: predictor methodology and the calibration study.
- Jorge: batch scoring service (the NNGP kernel computation batches nicely; CIFAR-10 subsets keep each score under a minute on an A100).
- Maren: data plumbing and the internal-workload integration.

One addition to scope, and it needs your blessing on cost: the calibration study needs expert judgments — engineers rating whether the predictor's accept/reject calls match their read of an architecture before ground-truth training lands. There's no tool for collecting that, so we're scoping and building a human-rating annotation UI from scratch: Jorge and Maren split a 5-week build for rating queues, side-by-side comparisons, rater agreement stats, and CSV export for analysis. It's generic enough that we'll reuse it every time we validate a predictor.

Compute is trivial otherwise — titan best-effort covers everything.

Bao
